hero.lead: Real bedtime tales for your child, every night. A ready-made narrator can read them, or you tell them in your own voice.
hero.note: Start on the free plan. The app and the tales are in Turkish and English.
hero.phoneHome: The Stories screen of the Sesly app: tonight's story, the category tiles and a shelf of bedtime stories.
hero.phoneStory: A story page: the cover, age and length tags, and below them the question Whose voice should read it? with narrator cards.

how.title: Story time in three steps
how.lead: Pick a tale, pick a narrator, turn off the lights. Sesly does the rest.

pick.title: Pick a tale
pick.text: Choose from bedtime stories, Turkish tales, world classics and educational stories, by age and by length.

voice.title: Choose the narrator
voice.text: Let a ready-made narrator read it, or record your voice once and the story is told in your voice.

listen.title: Listen and drift off
listen.text: Set the sleep timer. In the last minute the sound fades out gently and the story ends on its own.

features.title: Made for bedtime
features.lead: Everything in Sesly follows the evening routine: few taps, calm screens, real tales.
features.phonePlayer: The player screen: the story cover, the line Narrated by Mum, the progress bar and the sleep timer with the time left.

ownVoice.title: Your own voice
ownVoice.text: Read a short text on the screen once, and Sesly tells the stories in your voice.
ownVoice.privacy: The recording is taken only with your explicit consent and used only to make your voice; delete the voice or your account and the recording is deleted too.

narrators.title: Ready-made narrators
narrators.text: Start right away, no recording needed. Google's natural Chirp 3 HD voices are free on every plan, within the plan limits.

tales.title: Real tales
tales.text: Public domain folk tales and classics, and openly licensed (CC BY) children's books. No AI-written tales; tales translated from English with AI are clearly marked.

timer.title: Sleep timer
timer.text: Pick a length of time or a number of stories. In the last minute the sound fades out and the story ends on its own.

queue.title: Up next
queue.text: Add ready stories to the queue; when one ends the next one starts, and you can put the phone down.

parents.title: Notes for parents
parents.text: Every tale has an age group. Content such as a scary scene, death or a sad ending is pointed out before the story starts.

languages.title: Turkish and English
languages.text: The app and the tales come in both languages. You choose the story language; the ready-made narrators read in both too.

shelf.title: A few tales from the shelf
shelf.lead: The source and licence of every tale are on its story page in the app. Tales translated from English with AI are always marked.

plans.title: Plans
plans.lead: Start for free and upgrade later if you like. On the paid plans, stories keep playing with the screen off.

free.name: Free
items: 20 stories a month with ready-made narrators
1 story in your own voice, in total
free.limit: The story stops when the screen turns off

mini.name: Mini
items: 5 stories a month in your own voice

premium.name: Premium

notes.store: Subscriptions are sold only through Google Play and cancelled in Google Play (App Store coming soon). They renew automatically each period until you cancel.
notes.price: The price in the app is set by the store and may differ by country. Monthly allowances renew on the first day of each month.

free.a: Yes. On the free plan you can listen to 20 stories a month with ready-made narrators and make 1 story in your own voice. For more, choose the Mini or Premium plan.

record.q: How do I add my own voice?
record.a: From the My voice tab. First you agree to the explicit consent text, then you read the short text on the screen for at least 15 seconds; 30 seconds is ideal. The app lets you know when your voice is ready.

privacy.a: Your recording is used only to make your voice and narrate your stories; it is not used for advertising and never sold. The voice model is stored with our service provider Cartesia. When you delete the voice or your account, the recording and the voice model are deleted.

tales.q: Where do the tales come from?
tales.a: From public domain folk tales and classics, and from openly licensed (CC BY) children's books. There are no AI-written tales. Some English tales were translated into Turkish with AI; those tales say "Translated with AI". The source and licence are on every story page.

languages.a: The app and the tales are in Turkish and English. The ready-made narrators speak both languages too.

cancel.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
cancel.a: In Google Play, under Subscriptions. The cancellation takes effect at the end of the period. Deleting your account does not cancel the subscription.

ios.a: Not yet. For now Sesly is on Android, in Google Play. The iPhone version is coming soon.

delete.q: How do I delete my account?
delete.a: In the app, tap your profile icon and use Delete account at the bottom of the Profile page. If you cannot open the app, follow the steps on the data deletion page.

cta.title: Tonight, the first story is yours
cta.text: Download Sesly and play the first story with a ready-made narrator or in your own voice.
